tema: un paseo de otono por el Retiro, Madrid
idea: Un paseo otoñal por El Retiro en Madrid disfrutando de la luz de la tarde
texto: El Retiro en otoño es pura magia madrileña. 🍂 Da igual cuántas veces pasee por aquí, siempre tiene ese algo especial que me atrapa. ¿Cuál es vuestro rincón favorito de Madrid cuando empieza a refrescar?
escenas: Medium shot from the waist up of a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a cozy beige oversized knit sweater and a dark green scarf, posing gracefully against a backdrop of golden autumn trees in El Retiro park, Madrid, soft warm afternoon sunlight illuminating her face, gentle closed-mouth smile, relaxed posture, natural cinematic lighting

Close-up portrait of the same young woman in the same beige knit sweater and dark green scarf, soft autumn foliage blurred in the background of El Retiro park, looking thoughtfully to the side with a calm expression, mouth gently closed, warm golden hour sun catching her hair, elegant and natural look

Medium shot from the waist up of the same young woman leaning lightly against an old stone bench, wearing the same beige sweater and dark green scarf, surrounded by fallen autumn leaves, looking directly at the camera with a subtle, playful smirk, lips closed, soft diffuse daylight filtering through the trees
